instructions: Verified decision tree. Match the one leaf whose field conditions all hold, then return its label. Every declared input matches exactly one leaf.
If context=internal, action=change, return deny.
If context=internal, action=export, role=analyst, risk=FALSE, return review.
If context=internal, action=export, role=analyst, risk=TRUE, return review.
If context=internal, action=export, role=analyst, risk=UNKNOWN, return allow.
If context=internal, action=export, role=auditor, return allow.
If context=internal, action=export, role=operator, return review.
If context=internal, action=inspect, role=analyst, risk=FALSE, return review.
If context=internal, action=inspect, role=analyst, risk=TRUE, return review.
If context=internal, action=inspect, role=analyst, risk=UNKNOWN, return allow.
If context=internal, action=inspect, role=auditor, return allow.
If context=internal, action=inspect, role=operator, return review.
If context=partner, action=change, return deny.
If context=partner, action=export, risk=FALSE, return review.
If context=partner, action=export, risk=TRUE, return review.
If context=partner, action=export, risk=UNKNOWN, role=analyst, return allow.
If context=partner, action=export, risk=UNKNOWN, role=auditor, return allow.
If context=partner, action=export, risk=UNKNOWN, role=operator, return uncertain.
If context=partner, action=inspect, risk=FALSE, return review.
If context=partner, action=inspect, risk=TRUE, return review.
If context=partner, action=inspect, risk=UNKNOWN, role=analyst, return allow.
If context=partner, action=inspect, risk=UNKNOWN, role=auditor, return allow.
If context=partner, action=inspect, risk=UNKNOWN, role=operator, return review.
If context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, action=change, return deny.
If context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, action=export, return deny.
If context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, action=inspect, return review.
If context=sandbox, risk=TRUE, return deny.
If context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, return uncertain.

dsl.final_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.context == sandbox)) or (event.action == change)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == sandbox)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == operator) or ((event.context == partner) and (event.risk == FALSE))

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedInspect:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == inspect)
    then prefer label = review priority 80

rule ExportInSandbox:
    when (event.action == export) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AuditorInternal:
    when (event.role == auditor) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule TrustedForbidAllow:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = allow

rule OtherRoles:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (not (Trusted(event)))
    then prefer label = review priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:
    when ((event.action == export) and (event.context == partner)) and (event.risk == FALSE)
    then require label = review

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
    when ((event.action == export) and (event.context == partner)) and (event.risk == TRUE)
    then require label = review

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch3:
    when ((event.action == export) and (event.context == internal)) and (event.role == operator)
    then require label = review

predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.context == sandbox)) or (event.action == change)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == sandbox)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == operator) or ((event.context == partner) and (event.risk == FALSE))

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedInspect:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == inspect)
    then prefer label = review priority 80

rule ExportInSandbox:
    when (event.action == export) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AuditorInternal:
    when (event.role == auditor) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule TrustedForbidAllow:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = allow

rule OtherRoles:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (not (Trusted(event)))
    then prefer label = review priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:
    when ((event.action == export) and (event.context == partner)) and (event.risk == FALSE)
    then require label = review

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
    when ((event.action == export) and (event.context == partner)) and (event.risk == TRUE)
    then require label = review

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch3:
    when ((event.action == export) and (event.context == internal)) and (event.role == operator)
    then require label = review
